visual_name: Day in the life, part twenty seven: an ashtray now (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js pottery studio with shelves of pots, a kiln and a wall clock, box-built potter with a bandana and hoops, lathe-built pot that collapses, grows and squashes on a spinning wheel, phone sheets for mail / socials / message requests / group chat / spam / content / notification bell / chat DM, lock-screen banner on a bench phone, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 42.2 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a potter sends her draft at nine and checks email, socials, message requests and the brand's group chat for the approval; every check, the pot falls in. At four she finds it in spam: approved at 9:15, post by noon. Face in the clay. Then YourBrand: the draft goes in the app, a notification in the app when it is approved, and a chat message. Her hands stay on the clay. The pot is done, her phone buzzes, she jumps: it's an ashtray now.
